children: Japanese stocks may remain rangebound as concerns about higher borrowing costs offset enthusiasm over rising artificial intelligence-related demand. Nikkei futures are flat at 70175 on the SGX. The dollar is at 157.88 yen, compared with Y157.79 as of Monday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on any developments in the Middle East conflict, crude oil prices and bond yields. The Nikkei Stock Average rose 2.4% to 69946.86 on Monday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
